# Compiler errors that `swift build --build-tests` ALREADY produces on main.
#
# main at 32c5538 does not compile. This was not known before the first CI run on this repository,
# because scripts/build_native_fs_guard.sh exits on any non-Darwin host and the stations were the
# only thing that ever built the native half — which is exactly why three PRs have been able to hold
# 300+ Swift lines reviewed "by shape and call-site analysis only".
#
# Listing them here does NOT make them acceptable. It makes the native job useful in spite of them:
# a build that is simply allowed to fail catches nothing, whereas comparing the error SET catches a
# newly introduced compile error on the very first run that introduces it. The job fails when an
# error appears that is not listed here, and it also fails when a listed error stops appearing, so
# this file cannot outlive the defect it describes.
#
# Format: <repo-relative source file>: <clang/swift message, truncated at the first ';'>
# Line and column numbers are deliberately NOT part of the signature — they move whenever anything
# above them is edited, and a signature that churns is a signature nobody maintains.
#
# Both entries are missing DECLARATIONS, not missing functionality, and neither is safe to fix
# blind: `closefrom` is hidden unless the translation unit opts into the full Darwin C level, and
# `sandbox_init_with_parameters` is a private SPI absent from the public sandbox.h, so it needs a
# local prototype that has to match Apple's exactly. Getting that prototype wrong in a
# privilege-separation launcher is undefined behaviour rather than a compile error, so it is filed
# as its own change rather than fixed inside a CI pull request.
#
# Measured on macos-latest = macOS 26.4, Apple Swift 6.3.2, Xcode 26.5, SDK MacOSX26.5.sdk.

src/native/Recordings/Updater/VerifierLauncher/RecordingsVerifierLauncher.c: call to undeclared function 'closefrom'
src/native/Recordings/Updater/VerifierLauncher/RecordingsVerifierLauncher.c: call to undeclared function 'sandbox_init_with_parameters'
